extension.description: Unofficial graphical front end for the locally installed Kiro CLI, built on the Agent Client Protocol. Not affiliated with AWS or Kiro.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: Kiro Studio starts the Kiro CLI on the machine that holds your files and needs a real file system.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Kiro Studio starts an AI agent that can read and change files and run commands. It stays off until you trust the workspace.
viewsWelcome.untrusted:
Kiro Studio is switched off in untrusted workspaces because it starts an AI agent that can change files.
[Manage Workspace Trust](command:workbench.trust.manage)
viewsWelcome.cliMissing:

viewsWelcome.error:

config.cliPath: Full path to the `kiro-cli` executable. Leave empty to search the `PATH` and the usual install locations. Can only be set in user settings.
config.autonomy: Autonomy of new sessions. **Supervised**: Kiro asks before it changes files and shows a review at the end of a turn. **Autopilot**: Kiro works without that review.
config.autonomy.supervised: Kiro asks before changing files and shows a review at the end of each turn.
config.autonomy.autopilot: Kiro works without the end-of-turn review. See `#kiroStudio.autoAllowInAutopilot#` for permission requests.
config.checkpointsEnabled: Record what every turn changes in the workspace, so that you can view the changes and revert them. Needs Git. The snapshots live in a separate repository in the extension's storage; your own repository is never touched.
config.autoAllowInAutopilot: In Autopilot, answer every permission request of Kiro that offers "allow once" with "allow once" automatically. A persistent "always" option is never chosen automatically, the end-of-turn review is still yours, every automatic answer is logged, and Supervised mode always asks. Kiro's own deny rules still apply, because Kiro does not ask for those. User settings only.
config.hooksEnabled: Let Kiro load and run hooks from `.kiro/hooks` and `~/.kiro/hooks`. This includes your global hooks, which may run commands. User settings only.
config.specsCodeLens: Show "Start task" and "Update tasks" above the tasks in a spec's `tasks.md`.
config.defaultMode: Agent (mode) id to select in new sessions, for example `vibe`. Empty keeps Kiro's default.
config.defaultModel: Model id to select in new sessions, for example `auto`. Empty keeps Kiro's default.
config.defaultEffort: Effort level to select in new sessions, for example `high`. Only applied when the selected model offers effort levels. Empty keeps Kiro's default.
config.logging.level: How much of the conversation with the Kiro CLI is written to the "Kiro Studio: Protocol" output channel. Tokens, e-mail addresses and your home directory are redacted.
config.logging.messages: One line per message with its method.
